outcome_access_attestation.statement: Coarse local BugBank topic queries were deliberately used to rank candidate areas. No solver-generated claim was retrieved, no experimental receipt was made, no solver or model-auditor was called, and no BugBank or plain arm outcome existed before this freeze.

paired_run.plain_budget_rule: A plain full solution may stop immediately. If plain remains inconclusive, continue it incrementally until it has used at least the paired BugBank arm's total model tokens before allowing an inconclusive endpoint.
paired_run.stopping_rule: Stop either arm immediately at its first strict independently audited full solution or at a protocol-valid audited fixed point.

versioned_continuation_policy.selection: At the end of a validated 50-iteration block, continue all and only nonterminal arm-problem cells. Selection cannot depend on identity, arm, apparent progress, retrieved text, or paired outcome.
versioned_continuation_policy.starting_state: Continue from the exact byte-bound last revision, audit, token totals, and BugBank receipt history in the preceding validated block.
versioned_continuation_policy.versioning: Each required next block must have a separately preregistered disjoint run ID and runtime seal before execution. Already-terminal cells are never rerun. Repeat until every cell is terminal.

prelaunch_requirements: Commit and push the preregistration, ranked roster, source package, bootstrapped run, and all dedicated runtime programs before any experimental call.
Create the run with the repository's fresh-run bootstrap and validate every bound source and semantic-audit artifact.
Create a dedicated runtime seal only after the exact run manifest and dedicated runtime files exist on origin/main.
Require the run, operations, scratch, job-label, launcher, runner, validator, and seal namespaces to be disjoint from every other experiment.
Do not launch if a solver, model-auditor, per-claim BugBank receipt, or arm outcome for this cohort appears before the freeze is fully bound.
Require the independent validator to report VALID_COMPLETE before reporting any outcome.
purpose: Deliberately select six current open problems expected to exercise BugBank-relevant proof failure modes, then compare isolated BugBank and plain arms as a hypothesis-generating stress test.

confirmatory.description: The primary paired result contains 36 distinct targets. Its 58 protocol-stage observations include 22 continuations of targets from the original 31 and are not 58 independent problems.

outcome_blind_internet_six.description: The separately preregistered outcome-blind six uses study ID EXPLORATORY_UNBIASED_V2 and a selection rule that forbids BugBank relevance as a criterion.

reporting_boundary.policy: Always report this cohort in its own stratum. Do not add its solve counts to confirmatory or outcome-blind counts unless each stratum is also shown separately and the combined number is explicitly labeled exploratory and selection-biased.

targeted_stress.description: This six-problem cohort is intentionally enriched for expected BugBank relevance and cannot estimate performance on an outcome-blind problem population.

selection.method: Judgmental ranking by anticipated BugBank relevance after current-source and semantic eligibility review.
selection.reconnaissance_disclosure: Before freezing the exact roster, coarse local BugBank topic searches indicated relevant families involving graph coloring, Hamiltonicity, graph symmetric difference, connectivity and separators, residual flow, and reduction soundness. These were selection signals. They were not experimental per-claim retrievals and revealed no arm outcome.
selection.scientific_role: Mechanism-oriented and hypothesis-generating; intentionally not outcome-blind, representative, or confirmatory.

source_package.barbados_distribution_policy: No source license was displayed. Retain URL, HTTP metadata, full-PDF checksum, and only the two short necessary excerpts; do not redistribute the full PDF in this package.

status_review.conclusion: All six exact scoped targets remained open through 2026-09-04.
status_review.method: Review the latest primary source, run exact-phrase and title/topic web searches, inspect plausible later primary results, and record known near-results that do not settle the target.
